quotes.summary_phrase: Brayden Burries on prioritizing defensive mindset to maintain leads
quotes.excerpt: Before the game Taylor said look, shots in, out, that's going to happen, but it has to be defense.
quotes.quote: Before the game Taylor said look, shots in, out, that's going to happen, but it has to be defense for us. So what are you learning now that you're playing more minutes, you're in that starting groups and quarters? What are you learning about coming out with that intensity and starting with some of that defensive mindset to try to keep it, and then trying to keep it? The defensive mindset is just really the first, even the way you start a game and then that halftime, the first three minutes, I feel is very important. Set the tone for the rest of the half and that's the main thing. So if we can get stops early, then now we start hitting shots, now we're flowing.

quotes.speaker: Brayden Burries
quotes.summary_phrase: Brayden Burries on maintaining confidence during shooting slumps
quotes.excerpt: So as you lose confidence, it's over with pretty much, so you got to be out there with confidence.
quotes.quote: When things are frustrating, not going your way, how do you prevent that from shaking your confidence or your decision-making ability? That's one thing you can't do. You can't really lose confidence. So as you lose confidence, it's over with pretty much, so you got to be out there with confidence and just be strong-minded. Let's say that, because if you do that, you can be guarding somebody to hit a tough shot, our next play, let's come down, maybe get a foul or get in the paint, get a good look and then next play just try to make it hard for them over the course of the full 48.
quotes.social_post: Brayden Burries on staying mentally tough during shooting slumps: You cannot lose confidence because once you do it is over with. You have to stay strong minded.

structured.context: Brayden Burries discusses the necessity of maintaining confidence and a strong mindset during frustrating shooting slumps.
